articles.title: Skanska (OM:SKA B) Extends US Rail Work As Backlog Strength Keeps Undervalued Case Alive
articles.summary: Skanska (OM:SKA B) just added a US$136 million railroad improvement contract in northeast USA to its third quarter 2026 American order book, extending committed work on this project through December 2029. The fresh US contracts land after a choppy few weeks for Skanska’s stock, with a 7 day share price return showing a 5.24% decline and a 30 day share price return showing a 1.93% decline. articles.summary: Skanska (OM:SKA B) announced several large US contracts in education, healthcare, public infrastructure, and rail over the past week. The group also secured a US Forest Service grant to help shape insurance standards for mass timber construction in the US market. articles.title: Skanska (OM:SKA B) Stock Looks Reasonable After A 72% Three Year Run
articles.summary: Skanska has delivered a 71.6% share price gain over the past three years, which raises the question of whether its current market value is properly supported by the cash it is expected to generate. With a run of new construction contracts in the US now in the mix, the key issue for investors is how those projects feed into the intrinsic value suggested by its cash flows.
